taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V, 5 MHz)
* Architecture: input buffer -> dead-time generator (delay line + NAND/NOR)
*               -> matched tapered drivers -> PMOS/NMOS power stage.
* GN = A AND Adly (NMOS turn-on delayed, turn-off prompt)
* GP = A OR  Adly (PMOS turn-off prompt, turn-on delayed)
* => switches never on simultaneously; slightly inductive tank current
*    soft-switches SW during the dead time (class-DE operation).
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* ---------------- input buffer (small input cap keeps P_clk tiny) --------
XPI1 n1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNI1 n1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPI2 a n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNI2 a n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* ---------------- dead-time delay line: a -> b (non-inverting, ~1ns) -----
XPD1 d1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.4 w=1 nf=1
XND1 d1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.4 w=0.5 nf=1
XPD2 d2 d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.4 w=1 nf=1
XND2 d2 d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1.4 w=0.5 nf=1
XPD3 d3 d2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XND3 d3 d2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPD4 b d3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XND4 b d3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* ---------------- NAND2(a,b) -> x1 ---------------------------------------
XPA1 x1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XPA2 x1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XNA1 x1 a nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XNA2 nx b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
* ---------------- NOR2(a,b) -> y1 ----------------------------------------
XPB1 py a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XPB2 y1 b py vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XNB1 y1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=2
XNB2 y1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=2
* ---------------- GN driver chain: x1 -> gn (3 inversions, GN = a.b) -----
XPC1 x2 x1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=4
XNC1 x2 x1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=2
XPC2 x3 x2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=20
XNC2 x3 x2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=10
XPC3 gn x3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=100
XNC3 gn x3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=40
* ---------------- GP driver chain: y1 -> gp (3 inversions, GP = a+b) -----
XPE1 y2 y1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=6
XNE1 y2 y1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=3
XPE2 y3 y2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=30
XNE2 y3 y2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=15
XPE3 gp y3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=200
XNE3 gp y3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=80
* ---------------- power stage --------------------------------------------
XPPWR sw gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=6500
XNPWR sw gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2800
.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130 1.8V
* Architecture:
*   clk_in -> 2x input inverters -> break-before-make logic -> tapered gate
*   drivers -> PMOS (high side) / LVT NMOS (low side) power switches.
* Non-overlap is guaranteed by feedback: the PMOS can only turn ON after the
* NMOS gate is sensed low, and the NMOS can only turn ON after the PMOS gate
* is sensed high. Turn-OFF commands propagate immediately.
*   gp low  = PMOS on,  gp = buf(NAND(ck2, NOT(gn)))
*   gn high = NMOS on,  gn = buf(NOR (ck2, NOT(gp)))
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* ---- input buffer ----
XI0P ck1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XI0N ck1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XI1P ck2 ck1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XI1N ck2 ck1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* ---- gate sense inverters (break-before-make feedback) ----
XSPP gpb gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSPN gpb gp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSNP gnb gn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSNN gnb gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* ---- NAND2(ck2, gnb) -> np0 (PMOS-on command, active low) ----
XNAP1 np0 ck2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XNAP2 np0 gnb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XNAN1 np0 gnb nax vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XNAN2 nax ck2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
* ---- NOR2(ck2, gpb) -> nn0 (NMOS-on command, active high) ----
XNOP1 noy ck2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
XNOP2 nn0 gpb noy vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
XNON1 nn0 ck2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XNON2 nn0 gpb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* ---- PMOS gate driver chain (non-inverting from np0) ----
XP1P np1 np0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=88 nf=8
XP1N np1 np0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=22 nf=2
XP2P gp np1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=660 nf=66
XP2N gp np1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=264 nf=26
* ---- NMOS gate driver chain (non-inverting from nn0) ----
XN1P nn1 nn0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=40 nf=4
XN1N nn1 nn0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=11 nf=1
XN2P gn nn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=340 nf=34
XN2N gn nn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=136 nf=14
* ---- power switches ----
XPWP sw gp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=7200
XPWN sw gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=2880
.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier - SKY130 1.8 V core devices.
*
* clk_in -> small inverter buffer -> cross-coupled break-before-make
* logic -> tapered gate drivers -> PMOS/NMOS power stage on SW.
*
* Break-before-make (adaptive dead time, no delay line to trim):
*   pi = NOR (c, ngate)  ->  pgate =  OR(c, ngate)   (P on only if N off)
*   ni = NAND(c, pgate)  ->  ngate = AND(c, pgate)   (N on only if P off)
* Each power gate is driven to its off state directly by the clock edge and
* to its on state only after the opposite gate has been sensed as off, so
* the dead time tracks the real gate waveforms over P/V/T instead of a
* fixed delay.  It lands near 0.15 ns, short enough that the resonant tank
* current soft-switches SW at the heavy-load points without adding
* body-diode conduction time.
*
* Power-stage sizing: W_p = 38400 um, W_n = 18350 um, both L = 0.15 um.
* Measured Ron*W is 3310 ohm*um (pfet_01v8) vs 757 ohm*um
* (nfet_01v8_lvt), so W_p/W_n = sqrt(3310/757) = 2.09 equalises the
* marginal conduction/gate-charge trade-off; here 2.09.  The absolute
* width balances I_rms^2*Ron conduction loss (worst at R_L = 1 ohm) against
* C_gate*V^2*f drive loss (worst at R_L = 16 ohm).
*
* Geometry note: total widths of 3-7 um with per-finger widths below ~2 um
* select SKY130 model bins whose Vsat goes negative at 125 C (fatal in
* ngspice), so finger counts here keep every device out of those bins and
* wide devices are built from a w=50/nf=25 unit with the m multiplier.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* --- input clock buffer: deliberately tiny so the load on clk_in is a few
* --- fF and the power burned in the external 50 ohm source is < 1 uW.
XIB0N b1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.484 nf=1
XIB0P b1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.016 nf=1
XIB1N c b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.258 nf=1
XIB1P c b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.742 nf=1
* --- pi = NOR(c, ngate)
XNORPA NOR_m c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=35.226 nf=18
XNORPB pi ngate NOR_m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=35.226 nf=18
XNORNA pi c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.387 nf=3
XNORNB pi ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.387 nf=3
* --- ni = NAND(c, pgate)
XNANNA ni c NAN_m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16.774 nf=8
XNANNB NAN_m pgate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16.774 nf=8
XNANPA ni c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=17.613 nf=9
XNANPB ni pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=17.613 nf=9
* --- PMOS gate driver: tapered inverter chain (odd count: pgate = /pi)
XPD0N PD0 pi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=25.161 nf=13
XPD0P PD0 pi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=52.839 nf=26
XPD1N PD1 PD0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=5
XPD1P PD1 PD0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=10
XPD2N pgate PD1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=50
XPD2P pgate PD1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=104
* --- NMOS gate driver: tapered inverter chain (odd count: ngate = /ni)
XND0N ND0 ni vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=25.161 nf=13
XND0P ND0 ni vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=52.839 nf=26
XND1N ND1 ND0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=3
XND1P ND1 ND0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=7
XND2N ngate ND1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=24
XND2P ngate ND1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=50
* --- power stage: PMOS source/bulk on VDD, NMOS source/bulk on VSS
XPWRP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=768
XPWRN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50.0 nf=25 m=367
.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V).
* clk_in -> input buffer -> cross-coupled gate-sensing non-overlap generator
* -> tapered gate drivers -> PMOS/NMOS power half-bridge at SW.
* Break-before-make: NMOS gate can rise only after PMOS gate is high (PMOS off),
* PMOS gate can fall only after NMOS gate is low (NMOS off) -> no shoot-through.

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---------- input buffer: d follows clk_in (d=1 -> NMOS on -> SW low) ----------
XP0 x1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=6  nf=2
XN0 x1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3  nf=2
XP1 d  x1     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
XN1 d  x1     vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4

* ---------- NMOS turn-on path: ng = AND(d, pg) ----------
* NAND2(d, pg): pull-down (NMOS turn-on) slow, pull-up (NMOS turn-off) fast.
XPA1 na d  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XPA2 na pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XNA1 na d  nx  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8  nf=2
XNA2 nx pg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8  nf=2
* taper: na -> a1 -> a2 -> ng
XPA3 a1 na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=40  nf=8
XNA3 a1 na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20  nf=4
XPA4 a2 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=150 nf=30
XNA4 a2 a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=75  nf=15
XPA5 ng a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=6
XNA5 ng a2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=3

* ---------- PMOS turn-on path: pg = OR(d, ng) ----------
* NOR2(d, ng): pull-up (PMOS turn-on) slow, pull-down (PMOS turn-off) fast.
XPB1 py d  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=30 nf=6
XPB2 no ng py  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=30 nf=6
XNB1 no d  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XNB2 no ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* taper: no -> c1 -> c2 -> pg
XPB3 c1 no vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=100 nf=20
XNB3 c1 no vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50  nf=10
XPB4 c2 c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=4
XNB4 c2 c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=2
XPB5 pg c2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=16
XNB5 pg c2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=8

* ---------- power stage ----------
XPPWR sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=105 nf=21 m=315
XNPWR sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=105 nf=21 m=100

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier - SKY130, 1.8 V, 5 MHz
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Topology
*   CLK_IN -> input inverter -> interlocked (break-before-make) gate drivers
*   -> PMOS/NMOS power half bridge -> SW.
*
* Break-before-make interlock (no appreciable shoot-through)
*   ckb   = !clk_in
*   nd    = !(ckb . pgate)        ngate = !nd   (3 inverting driver stages)
*   pd    = !(ckb + ngate)        pgate = !pd   (3 inverting driver stages)
*   The NMOS may only be turned on after PGATE has been sensed high (PMOS off)
*   and the PMOS may only be turned on after NGATE has been sensed low (NMOS
*   off), because each turn-on path is gated by the *actual* gate node of the
*   opposite device.  The resulting dead time is self-timed (~0.9 ns) and
*   tracks process/temperature, so the two power switches never conduct
*   together: measured simultaneous-conduction power is 6 uW at 27 C and
*   0.4 mW at 125 C (leakage dominated), out of >90 mW delivered.
*   The dead time is also short enough that the resonant tank current
*   commutates SW most of the way to the opposite rail before the incoming
*   switch turns on (near-ZVS), which keeps switching loss small.
*
* Power-stage sizing
*   Measured on-resistance x width at Vgs=1.8 V, l=0.15 um:
*     nfet_01v8_lvt  744 ohm.um      pfet_01v8  3328 ohm.um
*   Equal-loss split for a fixed total width gives
*     Wp/Wn = sqrt(3328/744) = 2.05  ->  Wn = 21.25 mm, Wp = 43.75 mm
*   The total width balances conduction loss (~1/W) against gate-drive power
*   (~W); 65 mm total puts the two within ~20% of each other at the peak-
*   efficiency load, i.e. at the flat optimum.  Devices use 5 um fingers
*   (lowest measured Ron per width) and the 'm' multiplier for bulk sizing.
*
* Gate drivers
*   Three inverting stages per gate with a 14x taper and a 30x final stage
*   (a weak final stage minimises capacitive/crowbar drive power; the tank
*   itself does most of the SW commutation, so fast gate edges buy little).
*   The input inverter is minimum size to keep the loading on the 50 ohm
*   clock source - and hence P_clk - negligible (<1 uW).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
*
* --- input inverter: ckb = !clk_in (minimum size, low clock-input load) ---
XIN0N ckb clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
XIN0P ckb clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1 m=1
*
* --- interlock NAND: nd = !(ckb . pgate) ; gates the NMOS turn-on ---
XNDP1 nd  ckb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
XNDP2 nd  pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
XNDN1 nd  ckb   ndm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
XNDN2 ndm pgate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
*
* --- interlock NOR: pd = !(ckb + ngate) ; gates the PMOS turn-on ---
XNRP1 pdm ckb   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=0.76 nf=1 m=1
XNRP2 pd  ngate pdm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=0.76 nf=1 m=1
XNRN1 pd  ckb   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
XNRN2 pd  ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
*
* --- NMOS gate driver: 3 inverting stages, ngate = !nd ---
XDN0N dn0   nd  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1 m=1
XDN0P dn0   nd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=2.6 nf=1 m=1
XDN1N dn1   dn0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=15 nf=3 m=1
XDN1P dn1   dn0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=36 nf=7 m=1
XDN2N ngate dn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=200 nf=40 m=1
XDN2P ngate dn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=250 nf=50 m=2
*
* --- PMOS gate driver: 3 inverting stages, pgate = !pd ---
XDP0N dp0   pd  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=1 m=1
XDP0P dp0   pd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=5.3 nf=1 m=1
XDP1N dp1   dp0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=30 nf=6 m=1
XDP1P dp1   dp0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=75 nf=15 m=1
XDP2N pgate dp1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=210 nf=42 m=2

circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V supply)
*
* clk_in -> input squarer -> clkb
* Break-before-make logic with gate-voltage feedback (no shoot-through):
*   pnand = NAND(clkb, nfb), nfb = NOT(ngate): PMOS turns on only after NMOS gate is low
*   nnor  = NOR (clkb, pfb), pfb = NOT(pgate): NMOS turns on only after PMOS gate is high
* pnand -> 4-stage tapered buffer -> pgate ; nnor -> 4-stage tapered buffer -> ngate
* Power stage: PMOS (source/bulk = vdd) and LVT NMOS (source/bulk = vss) drive sw.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* ---- input squarer ----
XI0N ca clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI0P ca clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XI1N clkb ca vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI1P clkb ca vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* ---- gate-feedback sense inverters ----
* pfb = NOT(pgate), high switching threshold
XSPN pfb pgate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XSPP pfb pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* nfb = NOT(ngate), mid switching threshold (short NMOS-off -> PMOS-on dead time)
XSNN nfb ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSNP nfb ngate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* ---- NAND2(clkb, nfb) -> pnand ----
XNA1 pnand clkb na_x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA2 na_x nfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA3 pnand clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA4 pnand nfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* ---- NOR2(clkb, pfb) -> nnor ----
XNO1 nnor clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNO2 nnor pfb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNO3 no_x clkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNO4 nnor pfb no_x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* ---- PMOS gate buffer: pnand -> p1 -> p2 -> p3 -> pgate ----
XP1N p1 pnand vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1P p1 pnand vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XP2N p2 p1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XP2P p2 p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=25 nf=5
XP3N p3 p2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=8 m=2
XP3P p3 p2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=2
XP4N pgate p3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50 nf=10 m=8
XP4P pgate p3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=20 m=10
* ---- NMOS gate buffer: nnor -> n1 -> n2 -> n3 -> ngate ----
XN1N n1 nnor vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1P n1 nnor vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XN2N n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN2P n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XN3N n3 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=25 nf=5 m=2
XN3P n3 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=12 m=2

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V, 5 MHz)
*
* Power stage: PMOS high-side (pfet_01v8, L=0.15) and LVT NMOS low-side
* (nfet_01v8_lvt, L=0.15), sized with the instance multiplier m:
*   W_P = 6000 x 7 um = 42 mm  (~0.08 ohm),  W_N = 3000 x 7 um = 21 mm  (~0.035 ohm)
* W_P/W_N ~ 2 balances conduction loss against gate-charge loss.
*
* Gate driver: break-before-make interlock.
*   c  = NOT clk_in           (c=1 -> SW low, c=0 -> SW high)
*   ng = AND(c, pg)           NMOS gate rises only after PMOS gate is sensed high
*   pg = OR(c, ng)            PMOS gate falls only after NMOS gate is sensed low
* Each gate function is a small NAND/NOR followed by a 3-stage tapered
* inverter chain, so the dead time is set by the chain delay (~0.3 ns) and
* tracks temperature/process without shoot-through. The slightly inductive
* LC tank at 5 MHz then swings SW during the dead time (soft switching).
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* input inverter: c = NOT clk_in
XI0N c clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XI0P c clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* low-side gate: na = NAND(c, pg); ng = NOT na (3 inverters) = AND(c, pg)
XNA1 na c nax vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA2 nax pg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA3 na c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA4 na pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1N n1 na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=3
XN1P n1 na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=6
XN2N n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=15
XN2P n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=30
XN3N ng n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=75
XN3P ng n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=150
* high-side gate: no = NOR(c, ng); pg = NOT no (3 inverters) = OR(c, ng)
XNO1 no c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNO2 no ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNO3 nox c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNO4 no ng nox vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP1N p1 no vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=4
XP1P p1 no vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=8
XP2N p2 p1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=20
XP2P p2 p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=40
XP3N pg p2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=100
XP3P pg p2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1 m=200
* power stage (PMOS: s=vdd b=vdd; NMOS: s=vss b=vss)
XMP sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=6000
XMN sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=3000

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130 1.8 V core devices.
*
* Topology
*   clk_in -> 3 common inverters -> split into two skewed pre-driver paths
*             -> tapered buffers -> pgate / ngate -> PMOS/NMOS power stage -> sw
*
* Break-before-make is created open-loop by skewing the first inverter of each
* path: the P path has a strong pull-up / weak pull-down (its output falls late,
* which delays the PMOS turn-on) and the N path has a strong pull-down / weak
* pull-up (its output rises late, which delays the NMOS turn-on).  Both power
* device turn-OFF edges stay fast, so the two switches are never on together.
*
* Both paths contain the same number of inversions, so pgate and ngate move in
* phase (both high -> NMOS on, both low -> PMOS on) and sw = NOT(clk_in).
*
* Ron per micron at 1.8 V drive (tt, 27 C): nfet_01v8_lvt 742 ohm*um,
* pfet_01v8 3332 ohm*um, so W_p ~ 2.1*W_n balances conduction loss against
* gate-drive loss.  Power stage: 12.0 mm NMOS, 25.2 mm PMOS -> ~0.10 ohm
* effective series switch resistance.

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Common input buffer (kept small so the 50 ohm clock source sees little load)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XI0P a0 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=2.94 nf=1
XI0N a0 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

XI1P a1 a0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=14.7 nf=3
XI1N a1 a0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4.2  nf=1

XI2P a2 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=73.5 nf=11
XI2N a2 a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=21   nf=3

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* P path: skewed stage delays the PMOS turn-on, keeps the turn-off fast
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XP1P p1 a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=77 nf=11 m=2
XP1N p1 a2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=14 nf=2

XP2P p2 p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=98 nf=14 m=8
XP2N p2 p1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56 nf=8  m=4

XP3P pgate p2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=56
XP3N pgate p2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=16

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* N path: skewed stage delays the NMOS turn-on, keeps the turn-off fast
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XN1P n1 a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XN1N n1 a2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=21 nf=3

XN2P n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=98 nf=14 m=4
XN2N n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56 nf=8  m=2

XN3P ngate n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=28
XN3N ngate n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=8

*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Power stage
*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=360
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=172

.ends half_bridge

circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier - SKY130 1.8 V, 5 MHz
* PMOS upper switch (source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD)
* NMOS lower switch (drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS)
*
* Non-overlap gate drive: the clock C and its delayed copy D drive a NOR and
* a NAND in parallel,
*     ng = NOR(C, D)      (NMOS gate, active high)
*     pg = NAND(C, D)     (PMOS gate, active low)
* Both outputs depend only on C and D, so there is no cross-coupled race.
* On a rising clock edge ng falls immediately (NMOS off) while pg is held high
* by D, so the PMOS cannot turn on until the NMOS has been off for the full
* delay of the D chain; the falling edge is the mirror image.  Measured dead
* time at the power gates is 535 ps (fall) to 895 ps (rise) at 27 C and 125 C,
* which is long enough to block shoot-through and short enough to keep the
* body-diode conduction loss small.
*
* All geometry: l and w in micrometres (PDK scale=1u), w = total width,
* nf = number of fingers.

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Power switch unit cells (5 parallel devices of 1010 um each)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt hbn5 d g s b
X1 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X2 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X3 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X4 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X5 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
.ends hbn5

.subckt hbp5 d g s b
X1 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X2 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X3 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X4 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X5 d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
.ends hbp5

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Inverter cells, tapered  a -> y  (a y vdd vss)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv0 a y vdd vss
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
.ends inv0

.subckt inv1 a y vdd vss
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=13 nf=2
.ends inv1

.subckt inv2 a y vdd vss
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=55 nf=1
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=165 nf=2
.ends inv2

.subckt inv3 a y vdd vss
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1000 nf=10
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
X3 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10
.ends inv3

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Slow inverter used for the non-overlap delay line
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt dly1 a y vdd vss
X1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
X2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=5
.ends dly1

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2-input NOR  y = NOT(a OR b)   (a b y vdd vss)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt nor2 a b y vdd vss
X1 y a m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
X2 m b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
X3 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X4 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nor2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2-input NAND  y = NOT(a AND b)   (a b y vdd vss)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
X1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X3 y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
X4 m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Half bridge
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---- clock input buffer ----
XIB1 clk_in nb1 vdd vss inv1
XIB2 nb1 nb2 vdd vss inv2
XIB3 nb2 clk vdd vss inv2

* ---- delay line: D = clk delayed (4 inversions) ----
XD1 clk d1 vdd vss inv0
XD2 d1 d2 vdd vss dly1
XD3 d2 d3 vdd vss dly1
XD4 d3 dly vdd vss inv0

* ---- non-overlap combinational drive ----
XNR clk dly non vdd vss nor2
XND clk dly pg vdd vss nand2

* ---- NMOS gate driver chain (non high -> ng high) ----
XGN1 non g1 vdd vss inv0
XGN2 g1 g2 vdd vss inv1
XGN3 g2 g3 vdd vss inv2
XGN4 g3 ng vdd vss inv3

* ---- PMOS gate driver chain (pg low -> PMOS on) ----
XGP1 pg p1 vdd vss inv0
XGP2 p1 p2 vdd vss inv1
XGP3 p2 p3 vdd vss inv2
XGP4 p3 pgd vdd vss inv3

* ---- power stage ----
XN sw ng vss vss hbn5
XN2 sw ng vss vss hbn5
XN3 sw ng vss vss hbn5
XN4 sw ng vss vss hbn5
XP sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP2 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP3 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP4 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP5 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP6 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP7 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5
XP8 sw pgd vdd vdd hbp5

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier
* PMOS high-side switch, NMOS low-side switch, interlocked (break-before-make)
* gate drive.  PMOS: source=VDD drain=SW bulk=VDD.  NMOS: drain=SW source=VSS
* bulk=VSS.  The LC tank and load resistor are external to this DUT.
*
* Signal plan:
*   clk_in -> 4-inverter buffer -> cbuf (in phase with clk_in)
*   pgl = NAND(cbuf, ngdb)   pgl low  => PMOS ON   (ngdb high => NMOS is off)
*   ngl = NOR (cbuf, pgdb)   ngl high => NMOS ON   (pgdb low  => PMOS is off)
*   The cross-coupled feedback guarantees break-before-make; the two RC delay
*   elements in the feedback paths set the dead time.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---------------- input clock buffer (4 inversions) ----------------
XIN0 a0 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIP0 a0 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XIN1 a1 a0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIP1 a1 a0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XIN2 a2 a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XIP2 a2 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=1
XIN3 cbuf a2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XIP3 cbuf a2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=192 nf=1

* ---------------- interlocked non-overlap generator ----------------
* pgl = NAND(cbuf, ngdb)
XN1 pgl cbuf ns1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XN2 ns1 ngdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XP1 pgl cbuf vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XP2 pgl ngdb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
* ngl = NOR(cbuf, pgdb)
XN3 ngl cbuf vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XN4 ngl pgdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XP3 ngl cbuf ns2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XP4 ns2 pgdb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1

* -------- NG feedback: ngl -> (dead time) -> ngdb = NOT(ngl) delayed --------
XS1 ngs ngl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS2 ngs ngl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=0.42 nf=1
XSC1 ngs vdd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XS3 ngs2 ngs vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS4 ngs2 ngs vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=1
XS5 ngdb ngs2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XS6 ngdb ngs2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=96 nf=1

* -------- PG feedback: pgl -> (dead time) -> pgdb = NOT(pgl) delayed --------
XS7 pgs pgl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
XS8 pgs pgl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSC2 pgs vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XS9 pgs2 pgs vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS10 pgs2 pgs vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=1
XS11 pgdb pgs2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XS12 pgdb pgs2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=96 nf=1

* ---------------- PMOS gate driver chain (pgl -> pg), 6 inversions ----------------
XD0P pg1 pgl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XD0N pg1 pgl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XD1P pg2 pg1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XD1N pg2 pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XD2P pg3 pg2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XD2N pg3 pg2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=1
XD3P pg4 pg3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XD3N pg4 pg3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=256 nf=1
XD4P pg5 pg4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=1
XD4N pg5 pg4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=512 nf=1
XD5P pg pg5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=262 nf=1
XD5N pg pg5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10

* ---------------- NMOS gate driver chain (ngl -> ng), 6 inversions ----------------
XD6P ng1 ngl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XD6N ng1 ngl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XD7P ng2 ng1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XD7N ng2 ng1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XD8P ng3 ng2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
XD8N ng3 ng2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=1
XD9P ng4 ng3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XD9N ng4 ng3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=256 nf=1
XD10P ng5 ng4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=1
XD10N ng5 ng4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=512 nf=1
XD11P ng ng5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=262 nf=1
XD11N ng ng5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10

* ---------------- power stage ----------------
* PMOS upper switch: source = vdd, drain = sw, bulk = vdd
XMP sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10 m=82
* NMOS lower switch: drain = sw, source = vss, bulk = vss
XMN sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1010 nf=10 m=40

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier
* PMOS upper switch: source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD
* NMOS lower switch: drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS
*
* Clock input buffer -> break-before-make gate drive.
* Non-overlap:  yd = delayed(y);  NG = AND(y,yd);  PG = OR(y,yd)
* Both power gates therefore see dead time = delay before either turns on.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---------------- power stage ----------------
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=20 m=64

XIP1 y1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (PMOS high side / NMOS low side)
*
* clk_in -> delay line -> NAND/NOR non-overlap logic -> tapered gate drivers
*
* The delay line produces d, a delayed copy of clk_in.  The NAND output
* (pg) is low only while clk_in and d are both high; the NOR output (ng)
* is high only while clk_in and d are both low.  Therefore the PMOS and
* NMOS power devices can never be commanded on at the same time, and the
* delay sets a break-before-make interval at every edge.
*
.subckt hb_inv vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
.ends hb_inv

.subckt hb_inv2 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
.ends hb_inv2

.subckt hb_inv3 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=150 nf=2
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=2
.ends hb_inv3

.subckt hb_inv4 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=600 nf=4
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=4
.ends hb_inv4

.subckt hb_inv5 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1000 nf=10 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=10 m=2
.ends hb_inv5

.subckt hb_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1
.ends hb_nand2

.subckt hb_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XP1 y a n2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=60 nf=1

.ends hb_nor2

* Delayed copy of the clock (six inverters).
X1 vss vdd clk_in n1 hb_inv
X2 vss vdd n1 n2 hb_inv
X3 vss vdd n2 n3 hb_inv
X4 vss vdd n3 n4 hb_inv

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (PMOS/NMOS power stage).
*
* Break-before-make gate drive from a cross-coupled AND latch with an RC
* dead-time delay in the feedback path:
*   p = clk AND NOT(n_d)   (PMOS enable, active high)
*   n = ckb AND NOT(p_d)   (NMOS enable, active high)
* where ckb = NOT(clk) and p_d/n_d are delayed versions of p/n.  On a clock
* edge the conducting device is turned off immediately while the other
* device is enabled only after the RC delay, so the two power devices never
* conduct simultaneously.  The PMOS and NMOS gate driver chains are scaled
* proportionally to their loads so their delays match and the dead time is
* the same on both edges.

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* --- Clock inversion: ckb = NOT(clk_in) ---
XN0 ckb clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP0 ckb clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- Non-overlap latch, first NAND: ppre = NAND(clk_in, ndb) ---
XP1 ppre clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 ppre ndb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 ppre clk_in n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 n1 ndb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- Second NAND: npre = NAND(ckb, pdb) ---
XP3 npre ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP4 npre pdb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN3 npre ckb n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN4 n2 pdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- p = NOT(ppre), n = NOT(npre) ---
XN5 p ppre vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP5 p ppre vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN6 n npre vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP6 n npre vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- pdb = NOT(p_d), ndb = NOT(n_d) ---
XN7 pdb pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP7 pdb pd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN8 ndb nd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP8 ndb nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- RC dead-time delay (~1.1 ns) ---
XR1 p pd vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=10
XC1 pd vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=15
XR2 n nd vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=10
XC2 nd vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=15

* --- NMOS gate driver: n -> ng (non-inverting, 4 stages) ---
XN13 ng1 n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP13 ng1 n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN14 ng2 ng1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XP14 ng2 ng1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XN15 ng3 ng2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
XP15 ng3 ng2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=16
XN16 ng  ng3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=64 nf=16
XP16 ng  ng3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=32

* --- PMOS gate driver: ppre -> pg (non-inverting, 4 stages, 4.5x load) ---
XN9  pg1 ppre vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=9 nf=3
XP9  pg1 ppre vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=6
XN10 pg2 pg1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=36 nf=9
XP10 pg2 pg1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=72 nf=18
XN11 pg3 pg2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=144 nf=36
XP11 pg3 pg2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=288 nf=72
XN12 pg  pg3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=288 nf=72
XP12 pg  pg3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=576 nf=144

* --- Power stage: PMOS upper switch, NMOS lower switch ---
XMP sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=200 m=48
XMN sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1000 nf=200 m=11

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V power stage).
* Pin order: vss vdd clk_in sw
* - PMOS upper switch: source=vdd, drain=sw, gate=pg, bulk=vdd
* - NMOS lower switch: drain=sw, source=vss, gate=ng, bulk=vss
* - Non-overlapping gate drive (break-before-make) from a cross-coupled
*   NOR latch. A delayed /cn path plus a skewed ngate buffer chain set
*   a small dead time that avoids appreciable shoot-through while
*   keeping body-diode conduction short.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---------- Power stage ----------
* NMOS low side: R_on ~ 741/24500 ~ 0.030 ohm
XMN sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=3500
* PMOS high side: R_on ~ 3333/98000 ~ 0.034 ohm
XMP sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=14000

* ---------- Input buffer (inverting) ----------
XIN_N ck clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIN_P ck clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ---------- Delayed complement cn = NOT(ck) (~2 ns delay) ----------
* Slow stage: small inverter loaded by a big inverter gate.
XDL1_N a1 ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDL1_P a1 ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XDL2_N b1 a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=40
XDL2_P b1 a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=120
XDL3_N cn b1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDL3_P cn b1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

* ---------- Non-overlap generator (cross-coupled NOR) ----------
* phi2 = NOR(phi1, ck)
XPHI2_N1 phi2 phi1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPHI2_N2 phi2 ck   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPHI2_P1 phi2 phi1 m2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XPHI2_P2 m2   ck   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* phi1 = NOR(phi2, cn)
XPHI1_N1 phi1 phi2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPHI1_N2 phi1 cn   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPHI1_P1 phi1 phi2 m1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XPHI1_P2 m1   cn   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1

* ---------- pgate buffer: 3 inverters (odd) -> pg = NOT(phi1) ----------
XPG1_N g1 phi1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPG1_P g1 phi1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPG2_N g2 g1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XPG2_P g2 g1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=7
XPG3_N pg g2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=27
XPG3_P pg g2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=122

* ---------- ngate buffer: 4 inverters (even) -> ng = phi2 ----------
* First stage is a slow stage (small inverter loaded by a big inverter
* gate) so the ngate path lags the pgate path by ~1 ns.
XNG1_N h0 phi2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNG1_P h0 phi2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNG2_N h1 h0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=20
XNG2_P h1 h0 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=60
XNG3_N h2 h1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=5
XNG3_P h2 h1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=15
XNG4_N ng h2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=7
XNG4_P ng h2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=30

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V supply).
*
* clk_in is buffered to s; sn = /s.  A cross-coupled NOR latch generates
* the gate-drive commands with a break-before-make (dead-time) guarantee:
*   n  = NOR(sn, pd) = s AND NOT(pd)   -> NMOS  gate command (active high)
*   p  = NOR(s,  nd) = /s AND NOT(nd)  -> PMOS  gate command (active high)
*   pd = delay(p), nd = delay(n)  (non-inverting inverter delay chains)
* n and p can never both be high, so the two power switches can never
* conduct simultaneously.  Tapered inverter chains drive the big gates.
*
* Dead time per switching edge ~ 32 min-inverter delays (per chain).
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* ---- input buffer: sharpen the 5 MHz clock (s = clk_in)
Xib1p ni1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=1
Xib1n ni1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1
Xib2p s ni1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1 m=1
Xib2n s ni1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
* ---- sn = /s
Xsnvp sn s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1 m=1
Xsnvn sn s vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
* ---- break-before-make latch
* n = NOR(sn, pd): series-PMOS pull-up, parallel-NMOS pull-down
Xl1ap l1a sn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=1 m=1
Xl1bp n pd l1a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=1 m=1
Xl1an n sn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
Xl1bn n pd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
* p = NOR(s, nd)
Xl2ap l2a s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=1 m=1
Xl2bp p nd l2a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=1 m=1
Xl2an p s vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1
Xl2bn p nd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=1

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130).
*
* Architecture:
*   clk_in -> clock conditioning chain (edge sharpening)
*          -> cross-coupled NOR non-overlap latch (break-before-make)
*          -> tapered CMOS gate drivers
*          -> complementary PMOS/NMOS power stage on SW.
*
* The non-overlap latch delays each turn-on until the opposite device is
* confirmed off, so the two power gates never conduct simultaneously
* (no shoot-through), while the break is short enough that the body
* diodes only conduct for a fraction of a nanosecond per edge.
*
* Device choices (measured on the tt continuous models):
*   - power/buffer NMOS: nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 (Ron*W ~ 718 Ohm.um @27C)
*   - power/buffer PMOS: pfet_01v8      l=0.15 (Ron*W ~ 3237 Ohm.um @27C)
*   - power NMOS 12 mm total (w=1000 x m=12), gate ~15.6 pF
*   - power PMOS 28 mm total (w=1000 x m=28), gate ~29.4 pF
*
* All geometry stays inside the modeled per-instance range
* (0.15 um <= l <= 20.2, 0.42 <= w/nf <= 1010).

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Building blocks (fixed geometry, no parameters passed on instances)
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Minimum drive inverter: ~3.7 fF input cap.
.subckt iv1 i o vn vp
XMN o i vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP o i vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.3 nf=1
.ends

* 8x inverter.
.subckt iv8 i o vn vp
XMN o i vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMP o i vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18.4 nf=1
.ends

* 64x inverter.
.subckt iv64 i o vn vp
XMN o i vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=64 nf=1
XMP o i vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=147 nf=1
.ends

* Final driver stage: ~0.5 A class, drives the power gate in ~40 ps.
.subckt ivbig i o vn vp
XMN o i vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=500 nf=1
XMP o i vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=2
.ends

* 2-input NOR (cross-coupled latch core).
.subckt nor2 a b o vn vp
XMNA o a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNB o b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPA ma a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMPB o b ma vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends

*---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Half-bridge class-D power stage
*---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* Clock conditioning: sharpen the 2 ns edges from the 50 ohm line.
XB1 clk_in c1 vss vdd iv1
XB2 c1 c2 vss vdd iv1
XB3 c2 c3 vss vdd iv1
XB4 c3 cka vss vdd iv1
XB5 cka ckb vss vdd iv1

* Cross-coupled NOR latch: high-side enable neh and low-side enable nel
* are never both high; each rising edge waits for the other side to fall
* and for the feedback delay chain to confirm it.
XNHA cka dfb2 neh vss vdd nor2
XNHB ckb dfb1 nel vss vdd nor2

* Feedback delay chains (even number of inversions => non-inverting).
* Sets the break-before-make (dead) time, ~6 inverter delays.
XFA1 neh f1 vss vdd iv1
XFA2 f1 f2 vss vdd iv1
XFA3 f2 f3 vss vdd iv1
XFA4 f3 f4 vss vdd iv1
XFA5 f4 f5 vss vdd iv1
XFA6 f5 dfb1 vss vdd iv1
XFB1 nel g1 vss vdd iv1
XFB2 g1 g2 vss vdd iv1
XFB3 g2 g3 vss vdd iv1
XFB4 g3 g4 vss vdd iv1
XFB5 g4 g5 vss vdd iv1
XFB6 g5 dfb2 vss vdd iv1

* Low-side driver chain (4 inversions: ng follows nel).
XDL1 nel l1 vss vdd iv1
XDL2 l1 l2 vss vdd iv8
XDL3 l2 l3 vss vdd iv64
XDL4 l3 ng vss vdd ivbig

* High-side driver chain (5 inversions: pg is the complement of neh).
XDH1 neh h1 vss vdd iv1
XDH2 h1 h2 vss vdd iv1
XDH3 h2 h3 vss vdd iv8
XDH4 h3 h4 vss vdd iv64
XDH5 h4 pg vss vdd ivbig

* Power stage: PMOS upper switch, NMOS lower switch.
XQN sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=12
XQP sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=28

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V supply, 5 MHz).
*
* Architecture:
*   clk_in -> input inverter pair -> clk1 (inverted), clk2 (buffered)
*   ph1 = NOR(clk2, fb2) : high during the clk-low phase (PMOS phase)
*   ph2 = NOR(clk1, fb1) : high during the clk-high phase (NMOS phase)
*   fb1/fb2 = ph1/ph2 delayed ~0.8 ns (dead-time generator)
*   ng <- ph2 through an even-length buffer chain  (NMOS power gate)
*   pg <- ph1 through an odd-length buffer chain   (PMOS power gate,
*        active low).  Final drivers are edge-skewed: strong pull-down
*        for fast NMOS turn-off, softer pull-up for a delayed NMOS
*        turn-on; strong pull-up for fast PMOS turn-off, softer
*        pull-down for a delayed PMOS turn-on.  Together with the
*        feedback delays this guarantees break-before-make action.
* =====================================================================

* ---- small inverter ----
.subckt hb_inv1 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends hb_inv1

* ---- medium inverter ----
.subckt hb_inv2 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1 m=1
.ends hb_inv2

* ---- large inverter ----
.subckt hb_inv3 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=40 nf=1 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=1 m=1
.ends hb_inv3

* ---- extra-large inverter ----
.subckt hb_inv4 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=250 nf=3 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=500 nf=5 m=1
.ends hb_inv4

* ---- NMOS final gate driver: strong pull-down, softer pull-up ----
.subckt hb_ndrv a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=400 nf=4 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=250 nf=3 m=1
.ends hb_ndrv

* ---- PMOS final gate driver: strong pull-up, softer pull-down ----
.subckt hb_pdrv a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=200 nf=2 m=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=700 nf=7 m=2
.ends hb_pdrv

* ---- 2-input NOR: parallel NMOS pull-down, series PFET pull-up ----
.subckt hb_nor a b y vss vdd
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 m=1
XPA y a pad vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1 m=1
XPB pad b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1 m=1
.ends hb_nor

* =====================================================================
* Top level
* =====================================================================
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* --- input conditioning ---
XCI1 clk_in clk1 vss vdd hb_inv1
XCI2 clk1 clk2 vss vdd hb_inv2

* --- non-overlapping phase generator (cross-coupled NOR) ---
XG1 clk2 fb2 ph1 vss vdd hb_nor
XG2 clk1 fb1 ph2 vss vdd hb_nor

* --- feedback delay chains: weak inverter loaded by a large one ---
XF1 ph1 f1a vss vdd hb_inv1
XF2 f1a f1b vss vdd hb_inv3
XF3 f1b f1c vss vdd hb_inv1
XF4 f1c fb1 vss vdd hb_inv3
XF5 ph2 f2a vss vdd hb_inv1
XF6 f2a f2b vss vdd hb_inv3
XF7 f2b f2c vss vdd hb_inv1
XF8 f2c fb2 vss vdd hb_inv3

* --- NMOS gate chain (4 stages, even) ---
XN1 ph2 na1 vss vdd hb_inv1
XN2 na1 na2 vss vdd hb_inv2
XN3 na2 na3 vss vdd hb_inv3
XN4 na3 ng vss vdd hb_ndrv

* --- PMOS gate chain (5 stages, odd) ---
XP1 ph1 pa1 vss vdd hb_inv1
XP2 pa1 pa2 vss vdd hb_inv2
XP3 pa2 pa3 vss vdd hb_inv3
XP4 pa3 pa4 vss vdd hb_inv4
XP5 pa4 pg vss vdd hb_pdrv

* --- power stage ---
* PMOS upper switch: 38 mm total width, R_on ~ 90 mohm at 27 C
XMP sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=20 m=38
+ ad=250 as=250 pd=1020 ps=1020
* NMOS lower switch: 18 mm total width, R_on ~ 42 mohm at 27 C
* (2.1:1 P:N width split minimises total conduction loss for a
*  fixed gate capacitance budget)
XMN sw ng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1000 nf=20 m=18
+ ad=250 as=250 pd=1020 ps=1020

.ends half_bridge

circuit:
* 1.8 V, 5 MHz complementary half bridge.
*
* The two output-gate drivers are deliberately skewed.  PGATE has a strong
* pull-up and weak pull-down, while NGATE has a weak pull-up and strong
* pull-down.  Thus an active power device is turned off before the opposite
* device is turned on at either clock edge.
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* Small input inverter isolates the externally powered clock input.
XCLK_B clk_b clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=40
XCLK_N clk_b clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=100 nf=20

* PMOS gate: fast high (off), slower low (on).
XPG_P pgate clk_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=200
XPG_N pgate clk_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=200 nf=40

* NMOS gate: slower high (on), fast low (off).
XNG_P ngate clk_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=125 nf=25
XNG_N ngate clk_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=500 nf=100

* Power switches.  The PMOS has 2.5x the total width of the LVT NMOS; this
* balances conduction loss against the standard-PMOS gate/drain capacitance.
* M provides parallel identical multifinger devices.
XPOWER_P sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=200 m=50
XPOWER_N sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=500 nf=100 m=40
.ends half_bridge

circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier.
* clk_in (5 MHz, 50% duty, via 50 ohm source) -> non-overlapping gate drive
* -> PMOS/NMOS power stage -> sw.
*
* Shoot-through avoidance: cross-coupled non-overlap clock generator.
* The NMOS gate can rise only after pgate is sensed high (PMOS off), and the
* PMOS gate can fall only after ngate is sensed low (NMOS off). Sense
* inverters have skewed thresholds (poff trips at pgate ~1.2 V, noff trips at
* ngate ~0.55 V), and the final drivers are strong/symmetric so turn-off edges
* are fast. Dead time is set by sense+logic delay (~1 ns), which scales with
* temperature together with the driver delays, so non-overlap holds at 125 C.

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* Input buffer: clk_in -> c1 (small, keeps clock-source power low)
XPi0 c1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNi0 c1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* Gate-off sense inverters (skewed thresholds)

XNs0 poff pgate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPs1 noff ngate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNs1 noff ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* NMOS side: ngate = NOR(c1, poff)  (on only when clk=1 and PMOS off)

XPa2 nmid poff vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8    l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XNa1 nn1 c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt   l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XNa2 nn1 poff vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XPn2 nn2 nn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
XNn2 nn2 nn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt  l=0.15 w=20 nf=4
* Final NMOS driver: strong and symmetric

XP1 sw pg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=10 m=12

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (PMOS/NMOS complementary pair).
* CMOS-inverter-like power stage driving the external series LC tank.
*   PMOS upper: source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD, gate=pgate
*   NMOS lower: drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS, gate=ngate
* Both gates are the same polarity as CLK. Break-before-make comes
* from an AND/OR non-overlap on clk and clk_delayed:
*   ngate = clk AND clk_d  -> delayed rise (NMOS on late), fast fall
*   pgate = clk OR  clk_d  -> fast rise (PMOS off first), delayed fall

* ==================================================================
* Inverters
* ==================================================================
.subckt inv in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt inv1 in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv1

.subckt inv2 in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends inv2

.subckt inv4 in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
.ends inv4

.subckt inv8 in out vdd vss
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=512 nf=8
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=256 nf=8
.ends inv8

* ==================================================================
* RC delay + restorer -> clk_d (same polarity as clk, delayed)
* ==================================================================
.subckt delay in out vdd vss
XR in nd vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=8
XCM nd vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=7 l=7 mf=1
X1 nd n1 vdd vss inv
X2 n1 out vdd vss inv
.ends delay

* ==================================================================
* AND: out = a AND b
* ==================================================================
.subckt and2 a b out vdd vss
XMP1 nand a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMP2 nand b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN1 nand a nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN2 nx b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XINV nand out vdd vss inv
.ends and2

* ==================================================================
* OR: out = a OR b
* ==================================================================
.subckt or2 a b out vdd vss
XMN1 nor a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN2 nor b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMP1 nor a px vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMP2 px b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XINV nor out vdd vss inv
.ends or2

* ==================================================================
* Half-bridge DUT
* ==================================================================
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* Tiny input buffer keeps |P_clk| negligible
XIB clk_in clk_b vdd vss inv1

* Delayed copy of clk for non-overlap
XDLY clk_b clk_d vdd vss delay

* ngate = clk AND clk_d : delayed turn-on, immediate turn-off
* (even number of extra inverters keeps AND polarity)
XAND clk_b clk_d ng0 vdd vss and2
XGN1 ng0 ng1 vdd vss inv4
XGN2 ng1 ngate vdd vss inv8

* pgate = clk OR clk_d : immediate turn-off, delayed turn-on
XOR clk_b clk_d pg0 vdd vss or2
XGP1 pg0 pg1 vdd vss inv4
XGP2 pg1 pgate vdd vss inv8

* Power NMOS: d=SW, g=ngate, s=VSS, b=VSS
* w=20 nf=4 m=400 -> W=8000um
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=4 m=800

* Power PMOS: d=SW, g=pgate, s=VDD, b=VDD
* w=20 nf=4 m=1200 -> W=24000um
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4 m=2400

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (PMOS high-side, NMOS low-side).
* Gate drive: RC-delayed clock combined with the raw clock through
* AND/OR produces break-before-make non-overlapping gate signals.
*   ngate = AND(clk, dly)   -> slow rise, fast fall  (NMOS on late, off early)
*   pgate = OR (clk, dly)   -> fast rise, slow fall  (PMOS off early, on late)
* When clk != dly both gates are off (dead time) so there is no shoot-through.
* Power MOSFETs are sized with the 'm' multiplier.
* All NMOS use sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt as required.

* ---------- small inverter ----------
.subckt inv_s vss vdd in out
XMPS out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMNS out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv_s

* ---------- medium inverter ----------
.subckt inv_m vss vdd in out
XMPS out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=8
XMNS out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=8
.ends inv_m

* ---------- large inverter ----------
.subckt inv_l vss vdd in out
XMPS out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=64
XMNS out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=64
.ends inv_l

* ---------- huge inverter (power gate driver) ----------
.subckt inv_x vss vdd in out
XMPS out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=600
XMNS out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=600
.ends inv_x

* ---------- 2-input NAND: series NMOS, parallel PMOS ----------
.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b out
XMN1 out a ns  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN2 ns  b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand2

* ---------- 2-input NOR: series PMOS, parallel NMOS ----------
.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b out
XMP1 out a ps  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 ps  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nor2

* ---------- AND = NAND + INV ----------
.subckt and2 vss vdd a b out
XN vss vdd a b n1 nand2
XI vss vdd n1 out inv_s
.ends and2

* ---------- OR = NOR + INV ----------
.subckt or2 vss vdd a b out
XN vss vdd a b n1 nor2
XI vss vdd n1 out inv_s
.ends or2

* ---------- half bridge ----------
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* --- RC delay line: dly = clk_in delayed ---
XR1 clk_in dly0 vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=20 mult=1
* capacitive load on the delay node (MOS gate cap)
XDC dly0 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=1500
* square up the delayed edges
XINV1 vss vdd dly0 dly1 inv_s
XINV2 vss vdd dly1 dly inv_s

* --- non-overlapping gate signals ---
XAND vss vdd clk_in dly nraw and2
XOR  vss vdd clk_in dly praw or2

* --- gate buffers: 4 inverters (even) preserve polarity ---
XBN1 vss vdd nraw nb1 inv_s
XBN2 vss vdd nb1  nb2 inv_m
XBN3 vss vdd nb2  nb3 inv_l
XBN4 vss vdd nb3  ngate inv_x

XBP1 vss vdd praw pb1 inv_s
XBP2 vss vdd pb1  pb2 inv_m
XBP3 vss vdd pb2  pb3 inv_l
XBP4 vss vdd pb3  pgate inv_x

* --- power switches ---
* PMOS upper: source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=70000
* NMOS lower: drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1 m=35000

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130, 1.8 V power stage.
*
* clk_in -> input inverter -> NAND latch (intrinsically ordered break-before-make)
* -> edge-selective dead-time logic (turn-ON commands delayed ~2 ns, turn-OFF immediate)
* -> tapered CMOS gate buffers -> power PMOS/NMOS gates.
*
* Commands: a = PMOS-off (a=1 -> pgate=VDD), b = NMOS-off (b=1 -> ngate=0).
* Latch guarantees the turning-off command always moves first.
* pgate = OR(a, delay(a));  ngate = AND(NOT b, delay(NOT b)).
*
* NMOS power: sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt (excellent linear conductance).
* PMOS power: sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 (best pfet available in this model set;
*             pfets run ~40x weaker per width, so the PMOS is very wide and its gate
*             drive chain is pfet-heavy).
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---- input inverter: clk_in -> c1 = clk_b ----
XP0 c1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XN0 c1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* ---- NAND latch: a = NAND(clk_in, b), b = NAND(c1, a) ----
* clk high  -> a=0 (PMOS on),  b=1 (NMOS off).  clk low -> a=1, b=0.
* At each clock edge the turn-off command moves first (break-before-make).
XP1 a clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP2 a b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 a clk_in n1m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN2 n1m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP3 b c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP4 b a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN3 b c1 n2m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN4 n2m a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* ---- nb = NOT(b) : NMOS-on command ----
XPNB nb b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNNB nb b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* ---- delay chain on a (PMOS-on command path), 2 gate-cap-loaded stages ----
* Turn-ON waits for the delayed copy; turn-OFF never does (edge-selective dead time).
XDA1 da1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNA1 da1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCa1 da1 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=21 nf=3
XDA2 ad da1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNA2 ad da1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCa2 ad vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=21 nf=3

* ---- delay chain on nb (NMOS-on command path), 6 stages: longer delay ----
* NMOS turn-on waits longer than PMOS turn-on: the PMOS-off gate slew is the
* slowest turn-off, so the NMOS gets extra delay to guarantee break-before-make.
XDN1 dn1 nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNN1 dn1 nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCn1 dn1 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XDN2 dn2 dn1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNN2 dn2 dn1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCn2 dn2 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XDN3 dn3 dn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNN3 dn3 dn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCn3 dn3 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XDN4 dn4 dn3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNN4 dn4 dn3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCn4 dn4 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XDN5 dn5 dn4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNN5 dn5 dn4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCn5 dn5 vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XDN6 nbd dn5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDNN6 nbd dn5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCn6 nbd vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4

* ---- dead-time gating ----
* na = NOT(a), nad = NOT(ad): ppre = NAND(na, nad) = OR(a, ad)
XPNA na a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNNA na a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPNAD nad ad vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNNAD nad ad vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPPR1 ppre na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XPPR2 ppre nad vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNPR1 ppre na npm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNPR2 npm nad vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* nbdn = NOT(nbd): npre = NOR(b, nbdn) = AND(nb, nbd)
XPNBDN nbdn nbd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNNBDN nbdn nbd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNPR3 npre b npm2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNPR4 npm2 nbdn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNPR5 npre b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNPR6 npre nbdn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* ---- PMOS gate taper (6 inversions: pfin follows ppre) ----
XPB1 p1 ppre vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB1 p1 ppre vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPB2 p2 p1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNB2 p2 p1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XPB3 p3 p2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=3
XNB3 p3 p2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPB4 p4 p3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100 nf=15
XNB4 p4 p3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XPB5 p5 p4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=50
XNB5 p5 p4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XPB6 pfin p5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=150
XNB6 pfin p5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=7

* ---- NMOS gate taper (4 inversions: nfin follows npre) ----
XNB1n n1 npre vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNN1n n1 npre vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XNB2n n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XNN2n n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNB3n n3 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=5
XNN3n n3 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XNB4n nfin n3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=18
XNN4n nfin n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=50 nf=8

* ---- power stage ----
* PMOS upper switch: source=VDD, drain=SW, gate=pfin, bulk=VDD. W = 7u x 9000 = 63 mm.
XPP sw pfin vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=9000
* NMOS lower switch: drain=SW, source=VSS, gate=nfin, bulk=VSS. W = 7u x 1714 = 12 mm.
XNN sw nfin vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1714

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130)
* PMOS upper: source=VDD drain=SW bulk=VDD
* NMOS lower: drain=SW source=VSS bulk=VSS
* Non-overlapping gate drive from clk_in avoids shoot-through.

* ---------- inverters ----------
.subckt inv_s in out vss vdd
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends inv_s

.subckt inv_m in out vss vdd
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=4 m=8
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4 m=16
.ends inv_m

.subckt inv_l in out vss vdd
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=4 m=20
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=4 m=40
.ends inv_l

* Non-inverting high-current buffer for power gates.
.subckt buf_l in out vss vdd
XINVa in mid vss vdd inv_m
XINVb mid out vss vdd inv_l
.ends buf_l

.subckt nand2 a b out vss vdd
XMN1 mid a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMN2 out b mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends nand2

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* ----- input inverter: clk_in -> n1 = ~clk -----

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130, 1.8 V supply.
*
* Architecture:
*  - PMOS high-side / NMOS low-side power switches (m-multiplied fingers).
*  - Four-stage clock buffer regenerates the slow 50-ohm-driven input
*    clock into sharp complementary local clocks ck and c4 (c4 = NOT ck),
*    isolating clk_in from the large power-gate capacitance.
*  - Break-before-make gate drive: each power FET turns ON slowly through
*    a series poly resistor (its own gate capacitance is the delay
*    capacitor, so delayed turn-on lands near the tank-current zero
*    crossing and costs little), and turns OFF fast and fully via an
*    active helper device driven by the complementary clock c4. A diode
*    bypass would clamp the gate one diode drop above the rail, which
*    is above the LVT threshold, so active helpers are used instead.
*    The delayed turn-on of one switch always waits for the active,
*    rail-to-rail turn-off of the other, so the two switches never
*    conduct at the same time. Helper devices are sized so turn-off
*    completes well inside the smallest turn-on delay, keeping the
*    body-diode dead time (and its loss) small.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
*
* ---- clock buffer: four tapered inverter stages ----
* stage 1: small, light load on clk_in
XN1 c1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1 m=2
XP1 c1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1 m=4
* stage 2
XN2 c2 c1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
XP2 c2 c1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=24
* stage 3: strong local clock ck
XN3 ck c2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=48
XP3 ck c2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=64
* stage 4: complement c4, drives the turn-off helpers
XN4 c4 ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XP4 c4 ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=10
*
* ---- NMOS gate drive: slow rising ngate (delayed turn-on) through XRn;
* ---- fast, full-swing turn-off via helper XHN (on while c4 high = ck low).
XRn ck ngate vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=6 l=0.15 mult=1
XHN ngate c4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=48
*
* ---- PMOS gate drive: slow falling pgate (delayed turn-on) through the
* ---- parallel pair XRp1/XRp2; fast, full-swing turn-off via helper XHP
* ---- (on while c4 low = ck high).
XRp1 ck pgate vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=7 l=0.15 mult=1
XRp2 ck pgate vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=7 l=0.15 mult=1
XHP pgate c4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=96
*
* ---- power stage ----
XN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1900
XP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4000
*
.ends half_bridge

XNAND_P1 pgate c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8 m=75

XNOR_P1 ngate c nor_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8 m=50
XNOR_P2 nor_mid cd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=8 m=50
