taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier.
* Single 1.8 V supply, 5 MHz input clock.
* PMOS upper switch (source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD), NMOS lower switch
* (drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS).
*
* Digital break-before-make (dead-time) gate control.
*
* The two power gates are expressed as compound logic rebuilt around the
* power switches so each gate is a fast rail-to-rail edge driven by a strong
* low-impedance output stage:
*
*   ngate = din AND D(pgate)      (NMOS turns on only after PMOS is off)
*   pgate = din OR  D(ngate)      (PMOS turns off immediately, turns on only
*                                   after NMOS is off)
*
*   regen inverter chain produces dpg = NOT D(pgate), dpgb = D(pgate).
*   ngate driver: series PMOS pull-up (dinb, dpg) / parallel NMOS pull-down (dinb, dpg)
*   pgate driver: parallel PMOS pull-up (dinb, dng) / series NMOS pull-down (dinb, dng)
*
* D(x) is an RC-delayed copy of the gate signal regenerated by a small
* inverter, so the dead time is a real time gap between a fully-rail-to-rail
* turn-off and a fully-rail-to-rail turn-on, immune to Miller coupling from
* the switching node.  This keeps the dead-time interval short (~1 ns) with
* negligible shoot-through and minimal body-diode conduction.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Input buffer chain: clk_in - inv1 - inv2 = din
*
* inv1 is small -> low input capacitance, low clock power
* din high => SW low (PMOS off, NMOS on); din low => SW high
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XINVN n1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XINVP n1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.2 nf=1
XDRVN din n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XDRVP din n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
* dinb = NOT din
XDB_N dinb din vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=6
XDB_P dinb din vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=8
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Power stage (large devices)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS upper switch (drain=sw, gate=pgate, source=vdd, bulk=vdd)
XPP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=28 nf=4 m=1600
* NMOS lower switch (drain=sw, gate=ngate, source=vss, bulk=vss)
XNN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4 m=1000
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Delay tap D(pgate): pgate -> Rdp -> dpg_rc (stiff cap) -> small inv -> dpg
*   dpgb = NOT dpg
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRDP dpg_rc pgate vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=5
XCDP dpg_rc vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=13
XDPN dpg dpg_rc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XDPP dpg dpg_rc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
XDPBN dpgb dpg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XDPBP dpgb dpg vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Delay tap D(ngate): ngate -> Rdn -> dng_rc (stiff cap) -> small inv -> dng
*   dngb = NOT dng
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XRDN dng_rc ngate vss sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po w=1 l=5
XCDN dng_rc vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=10 l=13
XDNN dng dng_rc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XDNP dng dng_rc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
XDNN2 dngb dng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XDNP2 dngb dng vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=4
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* NMOS gate driver: ngate = din AND D(pgate)
*   pull-up  : two PMOS in series (dinb, dpg)
*   pull-down: two NMOS in parallel (dinb, dpg)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XANP1 ngmd dinb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
XANP2 ngate dpg ngmd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
XANN1 ngate dinb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
XANN2 ngate dpg vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* PMOS gate driver: pgate = din OR D(ngate)
*   pull-up  : two PMOS in parallel (dinb, dng)
*   pull-down: two NMOS in series (dinb, dng)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XORP1 pgate dinb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
XORP2 pgate dng vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
XORN1 pgate dinb pgmd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
XORN2 pgmd dng vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=320 nf=64
.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier.
* Power stage: PMOS high-side / NMOS low-side with a non-overlapping gate drive
* so the two switches never conduct simultaneously (dead time).
* All devices are SKY130 1.8 V MOS; the LC filter and load resistor are external.
*
* Gate-drive architecture (dead-time / non-overlap):
*   ck    = non-inverted buffered clock
*   ick   = NOT(ck)
*   ick_d = ick delayed by t_db (inverter chain delay)
*   ngate = NOR(ick, ick_d)  -> NMOS gate, delayed rising edge (delayed turn-on)
*   pgate = NAND(ick, ick_d) -> PMOS gate, delayed falling edge (delayed turn-on)
* While the delayed copy of the clock is still asserted, both outputs keep the
* power switches off; this creates a non-overlap window on each clock edge.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Inverter / gate cells (literal sizes)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inva vss vdd in out
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inva

XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
.ends invb

XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64 nf=16
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=32 nf=8
.ends invc

.subckt invdn vss vdd in out
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=128 nf=32
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=64 nf=16
.ends invdn

.subckt invdp vss vdd in out
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=256 nf=64
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=128 nf=32

* Large final power-gate drivers: fast gate edges so the outgoing switch is

.subckt invdn4 vss vdd in out
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=256 nf=64 m=4
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=128 nf=32 m=4
.ends invdn4

.subckt invdp8 vss vdd in out
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=256 nf=64 m=8
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=128 nf=32 m=8
.ends invdp8


.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b out
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1 out a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 m1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b out
XP1 m1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 out b m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130, 1.8 V, 5 MHz.
* Gate drive: delayed-clock dead-time logic (NAND/NOR) + tapered CMOS buffer
* chains. No ideal passives; all logic is MOS-only.
*
* Ron*W products extracted at the TT corner (Vgs=1.8, Vds=50mV):
*   nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 : ~757 ohm*um (27C), ~1018 ohm*um (125C)
*   pfet_01v8     l=0.15 : ~3186 ohm*um (weak temp dependence)
* Power widths: N = 8000 um, P = 26000 um.
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---- delayed clock: 8-inverter chain, even parity (cd8 = delayed clk) ----
XDC1 clk_in cd1 vdd vss inv m=1
XDC2 cd1    cd2 vdd vss inv m=20
XDC3 cd2    cd3 vdd vss inv m=1
XDC4 cd3    cd4 vdd vss inv m=20
XDC5 cd4    cd5 vdd vss inv m=1
XDC6 cd5    cd6 vdd vss inv m=20
XDC7 cd6    cd7 vdd vss inv m=1
XDC8 cd7    cd8 vdd vss inv m=20

* ---- dead-time combining ----
* ngate (active high) = clk AND clk_d : delayed rise, immediate fall
* pgate (active high) = clk OR  clk_d : immediate rise, delayed fall
XNGN clk_in cd8 nga vdd vss nand2 m=2
XNGI nga ng0     vdd vss inv m=2
XPGN clk_in cd8 pga vdd vss nor2 m=2

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130.
* Gate drive: cross-coupled NOR SR-latch non-overlap generator (dead time set
* by long-L inverter delay chains in the latch feedback paths), followed by
* tapered inverter driver chains into the PMOS/NMOS power switches.
* All-MOS implementation (no ideal passives inside the DUT).

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Small inverter, l=0.15 (wn=1.5 lvt nmos / wp=3.3 pmos)
.subckt inv vss vdd in out
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=3.3 nf=1
.ends inv

* Long-L inverter used as a delay element in the non-overlap feedback paths.
.subckt invd vss vdd in out
XN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.5 nf=1
XP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.35 w=3.3 nf=1
.ends invd

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* --- input inversion: cn = ~clk_in
XINV0 vss vdd clk_in cn inv

* --- cross-coupled NOR non-overlap latch
* ng_int = NOR(cn, ph_d)   (NMOS on when clk high, after p-side off)
XNOR1N1 ng_int cn    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNOR1N2 ng_int ph_d  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNOR1P1 xn1a  cn    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=6.6 nf=1
XNOR1P2 ng_int ph_d  xn1a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=6.6 nf=1
* ph_int = NOR(clk_in, ng_d)  (PMOS on when clk low, after n-side off)
XNOR2N1 ph_int clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNOR2N2 ph_int ng_d   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNOR2P1 xn2a  clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=6.6 nf=1
XNOR2P2 ph_int ng_d   xn2a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=6.6 nf=1

* --- feedback delay chains (set the dead time; even inverter count so the
*     delayed feedback keeps the latch polarity)
XD0  vss vdd ng_int d0  invd
XD1  vss vdd d0     ng_d invd
XE0  vss vdd ph_int e0  invd
XE1  vss vdd e0     ph_d invd

* --- n-side driver chain: ng_int -> npre -> a0..a6 -> ngate (8 inversions,
*     ngate = ng_int: NMOS on when ng_int is high)
XNA00N npre ng_int vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNA00P npre ng_int vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=3.3 nf=1
XNA0N a0 npre  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XNA0P a0 npre  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=3.3 nf=1
XNA1N a1 a0  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5    nf=1
XNA1P a1 a0  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=11   nf=2
XNA2N a2 a1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16   nf=3
XNA2P a2 a1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=35   nf=5
XNA3N a3 a2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=56   nf=8
XNA3P a3 a2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=126  nf=18
XNA4N a4 a3  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=140  nf=20 m=2
XNA4P a4 a3  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=140  nf=20 m=4
XNA5N a5 a4  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=140  nf=20 m=8
XNA5P a5 a4  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=140  nf=20 m=16
XNA6N ngate a5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=140 nf=20 m=32
XNA6P ngate a5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=140 nf=20 m=64

* --- p-side driver chain: ph_int -> b0..b6 -> pgate (7 inversions,

XPB0N b0 ph_int vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XPB0P b0 ph_int vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=3.3 nf=1
XPB1N b1 b0     vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5    nf=1
XPB1P b1 b0     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=11   nf=2
XPB2N b2 b1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16    nf=3

XPB3P b3 b2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=126   nf=18
XPB4N b4 b3  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=140   nf=20 m=2

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130.
*
* Power stage: PMOS high-side (source/bulk=VDD, drain=SW) and NMOS low-side
* (drain=SW, source/bulk=VSS).
*
* Gate drive: cross-coupled NAND/NOR non-overlap latch with feedback from the
* actual power-gate nodes.  Each power switch can turn on only after the
* opposite gate has already switched fully off, so shoot-through is impossible;
* the dead time is the self-timed buffer-chain delay.  Tapered inverter chains
* (fanout ~3 per stage) drive the large power FET gates.  clk_in sees only the
* small input NAND/NOR capacitances.
*
* Polarity: clk high -> low-side NMOS on (SW low); clk low -> high-side PMOS on.

* ---- 2-input NAND: PMOS parallel pull-up, NMOS series stack ----

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier with dead-time generation.
* Terminal order: drain gate source bulk
*
* Single-stage asymmetric buffer per gate for minimum gate drive overhead.
* PMOS gate: strong pull-up (fast off), weak pull-down (slow on)
* NMOS gate: weak pull-up (slow on), strong pull-down (fast off)
*
* Power FETs sized large for low Rds(on) while keeping gate drive power manageable.
* Buffer uses w=2.52 nf=6 (different from power FET w=5.04 nf=6) to avoid PDK bug.
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* === PMOS gate driver (clk_in -> pgate, non-inverting) ===
* Asymmetric inverter: strong PMOS (fast pull-up/off), weak NMOS (slow pull-down/on)
XBP1 pgate clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=6 m=650
XBN1 pgate clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=6 m=130

* === NMOS gate driver (clk_in -> ngate, non-inverting) ===
* Asymmetric inverter: weak PMOS (slow pull-up/on), strong NMOS (fast pull-down/off)
XBP2 ngate clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=6 m=130
XBN2 ngate clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=6 m=650

* === Power stage ===
* PMOS upper switch (drain=sw, gate=pgate, source=vdd, bulk=vdd)
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=6 m=26000
* NMOS lower switch (drain=sw, gate=ngate, source=vss, bulk=vss)
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=6 m=10400

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier, SKY130 1.8V, 5 MHz.
*
* Power stage: PMOS high-side (vdd->sw), NMOS low-side (sw->vss), very wide
* for low conduction loss (Ron*W: nfet_lvt ~780, pfet ~3290 Ohm*um @27C).
*
* Gate drive / break-before-make: clk_in is buffered to c; a short RC line
* makes a slightly delayed copy cd. Dead-time logic (NAND/NOR) followed by an
* ODD number of tapered inverter stages yields:
*   ngate = c AND cd  -> NMOS turns off early (c falls) / on late (cd rises)
*   pgate = c OR  cd  -> PMOS turns off early (c rises) / on late (cd falls)
* so both switches are never on together (shoot-through prevented by logic).
* The RC delay is kept small (~1.4 ns dead time per edge) so that, at heavy
* load where the tank current has not yet crossed zero, body-diode conduction
* during commutation is brief and its loss stays small. Tapered CMOS chains
* (~5x/stage) drive the large power-gate capacitance.
* All power/driver FETs use 1 um fingers (w=10 nf=10), which lie inside the
* modeled BSIM bin range (sub-um fingers hit a bad model bin).
*
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* ---- power switches ----
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=10 nf=10 m=4000
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=10 m=2000

* ---- input buffer: clk_in -> c ----
XU0N c clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XU0P c clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8     l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- RC delay line: c -> rcd -> (2 invs) -> cd ----
XRD c rcd vss sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po w=1 l=10
XCD rcd vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1   w=1 l=1

*  Half-bridge class-D power amplifier  (SKY130, 1.8 V supply)
*
*  .subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
*
*  Power stage : PMOS high side (source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD)
*                NMOS low  side (drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS)
*
*  Gate drive  : break-before-make.  With A = /CLK and B = A delayed by
*                the dead time t_d,
*                    ngate = A AND B      pgate = A OR B
*                Both gate drivers are inactive for the whole window t_d
*                after every clock edge, so the two power devices can
*                never conduct at the same time.
*
*  The LC series resonator and the load resistor are external.
* =====================================================================

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
*  Logic primitives
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Minimum inverter (clock input stage, low input capacitance)

XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XCAP out vss vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=180 nf=1

XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XMP2 y b n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1

XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=205 nf=1

XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

XN2 n1 n2 vdd vss inv_c
XN3 n2 n3 vdd vss inv_n3

XP1 pp p1 vdd vss inv_b
XP2 p1 p2 vdd vss inv_p2
XP3 p2 p3 vdd vss inv_p3
XPD p3 pgate vdd vss drvp

XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=58
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1000 nf=1 m=31

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier with cross-coupled NAND dead-time generator.
* Terminal order: drain, gate, source, bulk
*
* Cross-coupled NAND latch produces complementary outputs with built-in dead time.
* ngate_bar and pgate_bar are always complementary (one HIGH, one LOW).
* ngate = NOT(ngate_bar) through 1 inverter buffer
* pgate = pgate_bar through 2 inverter buffers (non-inverting)
*
* Correct polarity:
* CLK HIGH: ngate_bar=LOW -> ngate=HIGH (NMOS ON), pgate_bar=HIGH -> pgate=HIGH (PMOS OFF) -> SW=Vss
* CLK LOW: ngate_bar=HIGH -> ngate=LOW (NMOS OFF), pgate_bar=LOW -> pgate=LOW (PMOS ON) -> SW=Vdd

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw

* === CLK inverter (generates nclk) ===
XNCLK nclk clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPCLK nclk clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* === NAND1: ngate_bar = NAND(clk_in, pgate_bar) ===
XN1A ngate_bar clk_in nd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN1B nd1 pgate_bar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP1A ngate_bar clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP1B ngate_bar pgate_bar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* === NAND2: pgate_bar = NAND(nclk, ngate_bar) ===
XN2A pgate_bar nclk nd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN2B nd2 ngate_bar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP2A pgate_bar nclk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP2B pgate_bar ngate_bar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* === ngate buffer: ngate = NOT(ngate_bar) ===
* Asymmetric: strong NMOS (fast fall=OFF quickly), weak PMOS (slow rise=ON delayed)
XNGB_N ngate ngate_bar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XNGB_P ngate ngate_bar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1

* === pgate buffer: pgate = pgate_bar (non-inverting, two inverters) ===
* First inverter: intermediate stage
XNPB1 pgate_int pgate_bar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
XPPB1 pgate_int pgate_bar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2
* Second inverter: strong PMOS for fast OFF
XNPB2 pgate pgate_int vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
XPPB2 pgate pgate_int vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=8

* === Power stage ===
* PMOS: source=vdd, drain=sw, gate=pgate, bulk=vdd
XPPWR sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=256
* NMOS: drain=sw, gate=ngate, source=vss, bulk=vss
XNNWR sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=128

* === Weak DC initialization ===
* ngate_bar pulled HIGH (PMOS ON, gate=vss)
XWI1 ngate_bar vss vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=8 w=0.42 nf=1
* pgate_bar pulled LOW (NMOS ON, gate=vdd)
XWI2 pgate_bar vdd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=8 w=0.42 nf=1

.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130).
* PMOS upper switch: source=VDD drain=SW gate=pgate bulk=VDD
* NMOS lower switch: drain=SW source=VSS gate=ngate bulk=VSS
* Dead time (break-before-make, no shoot-through) is made with FEED-FORWARD
* logic (no cross-coupled latch, so no metastable DC operating point):
*   ngate = AND(d, d_delay)   -> NMOS turns on only after d_delay catches up,
*                                turns off instantly when d falls.
*   pgate = NAND(dbar, dbar_delay) -> PMOS gate (low=on); PMOS turns on only
*                                after dbar_delay catches up, off instantly.
* where d = not(clk_in), dbar = not(d). The external series-resonant LC (~5 MHz)
* keeps load current near zero at switching edges, so switching loss is low.
* nf=1 throughout (some multi-finger W/L bins hit an unphysical Pclm); total
* width is scaled with the m multiplier.
.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* --- d = not(clk_in), dbar = not(d) ---
Xd1  d    clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
Xd2  d    clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
Xb1  dbar d      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
Xb2  dbar d      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=1
* --- delay chains (odd inverter count keeps polarity): dd=delay(d), dbard=delay(dbar) ---
Xdd1  dd1  d    vdd vss inv
Xdd2  dd2  dd1  vdd vss inv
Xdd3  dd3  dd2  vdd vss inv
Xdd4  dd4  dd3  vdd vss inv
Xdd5  dd5  dd4  vdd vss inv
Xdd6  dd6  dd5  vdd vss inv
Xdd7  dd   dd6  vdd vss inv
Xbd1  bd1  dbar vdd vss inv
Xbd2  bd2  bd1  vdd vss inv
Xbd3  bd3  bd2  vdd vss inv
Xbd4  bd4  bd3  vdd vss inv
Xbd5  bd5  bd4  vdd vss inv
Xbd6  bd6  bd5  vdd vss inv
Xbd7  dbard bd6  vdd vss inv
* --- ngate = AND(d, dd) = inv(NAND(d, dd)); 3-stage buffer (odd -> AND) ---
Xnn  nandn d   dd    vdd vss nand2
Xg1  ng1   nandn vdd vss inv
Xg2  ng2   ng1   vdd vss invs
Xg3  ngate ng2   vdd vss invd
* --- pgate = NAND(dbar, dbard); 4-stage buffer (even -> NAND polarity) ---
Xnp  nandp dbar dbard vdd vss nand2
Xp1  pg1   nandp vdd vss inv
Xp2  pg2   pg1   vdd vss invs
Xp3  pg3   pg2   vdd vss invd
Xp4  pgate pg3   vdd vss inv
* --- power FETs ---
XMP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4000
XMN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=2000
.ends half_bridge

* --- helper: minimum inverter ---
.subckt inv in vdd vss out
Xmp out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
Xmn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends inv

* --- helper: medium-strength inverter (m=4) ---
.subckt invs in vdd vss out
Xmp out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
Xmn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=4
.ends invs

* --- helper: buffer-driver inverter (drives the power gate) ---
.subckt invd in vdd vss out
Xmp out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=22
Xmn out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=22
.ends invd

* --- helper: 2-input NAND (NMOS series, PMOS parallel) ---
.subckt nand2 a b vdd vss out
Xmp1 out a   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
Xmp2 out b   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8      l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
Xmn1 out a   n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
Xmn2 n1  b   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1 m=1
.ends nand2

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier.
* External 5 MHz clock at clk_in (via 50 ohm series resistor) drives a
* non-overlap gate driver producing complementary power-switch gate drives
* with a short dead time, then the switched output at sw.
* LC series resonator + R_L are external to this DUT.

* --- small inverter primitive (scaled via subckt m= multiplier) ---
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1
.ends inv

* --- 2-input NOR: y high only when a=b=0 ---
.subckt nor2 a b y vss vdd
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XN1 y a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1
XN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3.5 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt half_bridge vss vdd clk_in sw
* clk_in -> clkb (complement)
XIB clkb clk_in vss vdd inv

* --- non-overlap generator (cross-coupled NOR with inverter-chain delay) ---
* n1 = NOR(clkb, pd)   -> NMOS enable (high = on)
* p1 = NOR(clk_in, nd) -> PMOS enable (high = on)
XNORn n1 clkb pd vss vdd nor2
XNORp p1 clk_in nd vss vdd nor2
* delay element = even inverter chain (non-inverting delay of n1 -> nd, p1 -> pd)
XND1 nd1 n1 vss vdd inv
XND2 nd2 nd1 vss vdd inv
XND3 nd3 nd2 vss vdd inv
XND4 nd4 nd3 vss vdd inv
XND5 nd5 nd4 vss vdd inv
XND6 nd nd5 vss vdd inv
XPD1 pd1 p1 vss vdd inv
XPD2 pd2 pd1 vss vdd inv
XPD3 pd3 pd2 vss vdd inv
XPD4 pd4 pd3 vss vdd inv
XPD5 pd5 pd4 vss vdd inv
XPD6 pd pd5 vss vdd inv

* --- NMOS gate buffer (non-inverting, 4 stages) : ngate = n1 ---
XNB1 ng1 n1 vss vdd inv m=2
XNB2 ng2 ng1 vss vdd inv m=8
XNB3 ng3 ng2 vss vdd inv m=32
XNB4 ngate ng3 vss vdd inv m=128

* --- PMOS gate buffer (inverting, 3 stages) : pgate = NOT p1 ---
XPB1 pg1 p1 vss vdd inv m=2
XPB2 pg2 pg1 vss vdd inv m=8
XPB3 pgate pg2 vss vdd inv m=128

* --- power stage ---
* PMOS upper switch: source=VDD, drain=SW, gate=pgate, bulk=VDD
XPWRP sw pgate vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=160
* NMOS lower switch: drain=SW, gate=ngate, source=VSS, bulk=VSS
XPWRN sw ngate vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=70 nf=10 m=80
.ends half_bridge

taskTitle: Design a Half-Bridge Class-D Power Amplifier
circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (SKY130, 1.8 V).
*
* Topology:
*   - PMOS high-side switch (source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD)
*   - NMOS low-side switch  (drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS)
*   - Break-before-make gate drive: an internal clock c and a delayed copy d
*     feed  ngate = AND(c,d)  (NMOS, active high)  and  pgate = OR(c,d)
*     (PMOS, active low).  Each FET turns off immediately on the clock edge
*     and turns on only after the dead-time delay => no shoot-through.
*   - Tapered buffer chains drive the large power-FET gates fast.
*
* Only PDK subcircuits (MOS) are used; no ideal passives.

* ---- logic primitives -------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv out in vss vdd

* All-MOS gate drive: input inverter snaps the clock (d1), then rail-to-rail
* NAND/NOR dead-time drive switches the power stage.
* No ideal elements inside DUT.
* MOS terminal order: drain gate source bulk  (PMOS bulk=VDD, NMOS bulk=VSS)
* PMOS: drain=SW, gate=pgate, source=VDD, bulk=VDD
* NMOS: drain=SW, gate=ngate, source=VSS, bulk=VSS

xinv1 d1 clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
xinv2 d1 clk_in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
xinv3 clk_d d1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
xinv4 clk_d d1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1

xpg2 pgate clk_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=200 nf=4

circuit:
* Half-bridge class-D power amplifier (v4)
* PMOS upper switch: source=VDD, drain=SW, bulk=VDD
* NMOS lower switch: drain=SW, source=VSS, bulk=VSS
* Gate drive: ngate = clk_in, pgate = clk_in, with a few-ns dead-time to avoid shoot-through.
* Dead time: clk rising -> pgate rises (PMOS off) before ngate rises (NMOS on);
*             clk falling -> ngate falls (NMOS off) before pgate falls (PMOS on).
* Strategy: a weak device in the LOW-capacitance signal path sets a small delay;
*           a strong driver then rails each power gate fully and fast. No series
*           resistor in the power-gate path, so gates rail to the full supply.
* Only SKY130 MOS wrapper subcircuits are used inside the DUT.

Xp0 na clk_in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

XpE ngate nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=120 nf=24
